description: Machine-readable registry of AiXia QA review panels and required combined agents, aligned with qa-agent/qa-agent-council.md.

panels.name: Design Panel
approvalRules: Design and UX Excellence Agent and Design System and Frontend Quality Agent must agree on shared design-system direction before approval.
Synthetic User QA Agent must confirm evidence supports the reported design defect.
Final Council Chair must record APPROVED, NEEDS REVIEW, or REJECTED with scope and non-changes.
blockingRules: Reject page-local design drift when a shared component or shared CSS fix is required.
Reject approval when evidence does not show the visual defect across the stated viewport and role.

panels.name: Functional Engineering Panel
usedFor: Create, edit, archive, delete, and restore
approvalRules: Include Security, Permissions, and Tenant Isolation Agent when permissions, record-level access, or tenant boundaries may cause the defect.
Final Council Chair must align fix strategy with evidence and with shared AiXia source-of-truth rules.
blockingRules: Block approval when reproduction steps or console and network evidence are missing for user-visible breakage.
Block approval when a proposed fix bypasses permissions or creates unsafe automation.

panels.name: Business Logic Panel
approvalRules: Include Backend, Database, and Reliability Agent when backend or persisted data state likely causes incorrect lifecycle behavior.
Security agent must validate that proposed visibility matches role and tenant policy.
blockingRules: Block approval when business rule intent is unclear or contradicts finance and HR boundaries.
Block approval when schema or data-state assumptions are unverified for Supabase-backed behavior.

panels.name: HR Panel
approvalRules: Include Product and SaaS Strategy Agent when SaaS customer value, onboarding, or commercial packaging is materially impacted.
Security agent must confirm employee-facing surfaces do not expose admin-only HR data.
blockingRules: Block approval when employee privacy or HR and finance boundary risks are unresolved.
Block approval when payroll ownership and handoff responsibilities are ambiguous.

panels.name: Technical Panel
approvalRules: Include Design System and Frontend Quality Agent when frontend rendering or hydration is implicated.
Include Security, Permissions, and Tenant Isolation Agent when errors suggest permission, RLS, or tenant isolation problems.
blockingRules: Block approval when root cause is guessed without logs, traces, or schema verification where needed.
Block approval when proposed fixes would clear visible UI state on silent refresh failure.

panels.name: AI and MCP Panel
usedFor: Owner AI, tenant AI, and personal AI boundary
approvalRules: Include Personal AI Productivity Agent when memory, personalization, voice, avatar, or user productivity workflows are involved.
Include Tools, Integrations, and Commercial Open Source Agent when vendor or integration selection is part of the decision.
All required agents must agree before APPROVED; otherwise mark NEEDS REVIEW per council rules.
blockingRules: Block approval when tool contracts omit tenant boundary, role checks, confirmation, or audit requirements.
Block approval when AI could exceed manual user permissions or bypass RLS intent.

panels.name: Personal AI Panel
approvalRules: Security agent must confirm memory and tool access respect tenant and role boundaries.
Personal AI Productivity Agent must confirm user controls and privacy posture are adequate for proposed memory use.
blockingRules: Block approval when personal AI could learn from unauthorized records or cross user boundaries.
Block approval when destructive or sensitive actions lack confirmation, cancel path, and audit.

panels.name: SaaS Conversion Panel
approvalRules: Security and backend agents must agree on tenant isolation, RLS posture, and entitlement enforcement before APPROVED.
Product and SaaS Strategy Agent must confirm customer value and packaging coherence for SaaS-facing changes.
blockingRules: Block approval when cross-tenant leakage risk exists or is unverified.
Block approval when plan entitlements, billing boundaries, or per-tenant configuration rules are undefined for the proposed feature.
